question: At the same 576 policy calls and six fresh branch-data collections, does a second clipped optimizer update improve causal-action learning over one update while preserving the local-credit reduction in non-causal drift?

adversarial_review.verdict: Proceed only as a bounded bridge. Two epochs are not expected to beat stock at matched calls because they provide 12 versus 36 optimizer updates. E1 is required to isolate reuse from the practical-loss transition, and branch-global LOO is required for a matched-data/update credit comparator.
changes_adopted: primary comparison is local E2 versus local E1, not ReDCO versus stock
global LOO excludes the current branch record
no rollout between the two updates
squared log-ratio is no longer called KL
one bridge only, followed by Stage D prerequisites

branch-global-e2.credit: leave-one-out baseline over every branch record in the completed batch
branch-global-e2.labeling_rule: This is a matched-data diagnostic and must never be called stock or broadcast GRPO.

stock.role: economic Pareto comparator; beating it is not a success requirement

practical_loss.second_epoch_semantics: PPO-style known-ratio off-policy surrogate against behavior logprobs frozen at collection time

reuse_contract.transport: content-identical TrainingBatch.examples at consecutive trainer steps; only TrainingBatch.step changes
reuse_contract.dispatch: strict rollout gate is closed before epoch one and remains closed through application of epoch-two weights
reuse_contract.fresh_collection: sampling resumes only after epoch-two policy is applied
preflight: real sender-path mock proves identical object stream and consecutive steps
live two-update integration smoke proves content-identical serialized batches and no even-step rollout trace
single-adapter ordinary-matmul fallback is active symmetrically in all arms

reuse_efficiency: causal non-delta target-mass AUC over aligned policy-call checkpoints, local E2 versus local E1
the same exact-score curve indexed by optimizer update
credit_quality: delta-route exact categorical JS drift from initialization, local E2 versus branch-global E2
economic_pareto: stock causal learning at matched calls
generated tokens, total tokens, service time, wall clock, and GPU-hours
stability: exact categorical KL and JS between scored checkpoints

engineering_pass: all E2 batch pairs have content-identical examples
behavior snapshot versions advance only after epoch two
no rollout trace exists at the even reuse step
every run records exactly 576 training policy calls
reuse_efficiency_pass: local E2 causal AUC exceeds local E1 in at least two of three paired seeds
mean local E2 final causal gain is at least 1.5 times mean local E1 final causal gain
matched_data_credit_pass: branch-global E2 mean delta-route JS is at least 0.002
local E2 mean delta-route JS is at most 75 percent of branch-global E2
within every seed local E2 delta-route JS is no more than branch-global E2 plus 0.002
frozen_decision_rules.saturation_guard: AUC remains primary. If causal target mass reaches 0.98, report calls-to-0.98 and do not impose an impossible endpoint margin.
frozen_decision_rules.reporting: Engineering, reuse-efficiency, matched-data-credit, and stock Pareto outcomes are reported separately. No post-hoc composite score is permitted.
frozen_decision_rules.terminal_interpretation: Failure of a scientific threshold is a completed negative result, not grounds for retuning.

scope_limits: A pass does not show dominance over stock GRPO.
A pass does not restore unbiased on-policy semantics after the first update.
A pass does not validate batch reuse for long multi-token Stage D macro-actions.
This phase does not clear the independent Stage D environment, incumbent, judge, or cost-ledger blockers.

repair_and_stop_policy.before_any_scientific_arm_outcome: At most one documented redeployment is allowed for a demonstrated outcome-independent environment or infrastructure failure.
repair_and_stop_policy.after_an_arm_outcome: Never rerun an observed arm. Unobserved frozen arms may continue from the identical initialization.
repair_and_stop_policy.scientific_instability: Nonfinite gradients or ratios and heavy clipping are outcomes, not repairable environment failures.
repair_and_stop_policy.after_stage_c9: Stop synthetic efficiency tuning. Whether E2 passes or fails, proceed only to the already-listed Stage D prerequisites; do not retune K, epoch count, learning rate, or thresholds.

retain_compact_locally: control logs, metrics, rollout traces, and serialized training batches
exact checkpoint score payload and signed decision
compressed evidence bundle and billing report
do_not_retain_locally: checkpoint adapter weights after hashes and exact scores are recorded
